theorem squareAverage_covering_iterate_real {f : Plane → ℝ}
    (hf : Continuous f)
    (hp : ∀ z : Plane, ∀ k : Frequency, f (z + ((k.1 : ℝ), (k.2 : ℝ))) = f z)
    (n : ℕ) : squareAverage (fun z => f (covering^[n] z)) = squareAverage f
